items.title: The Hall Keep
items.description: A castle: a great hall, a tower, barracks, an armory, a garden and a pool. A party meets goblins and an ogre.
items.author: Inkstone

items.title: The Rusty Flagon
items.description: A busy tavern with a kitchen, a cellar full of rats, two guest rooms and a yard.
items.author: Inkstone

items.title: Crossroads Ambush
items.description: An overturned wagon at a crossroads, trees to hide in and bandits waiting.
items.author: Inkstone
